info.title: TukiFact API
info.description: TukiFact HTTP API. Errors are RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` bodies with `traceId`, `correlationId` and, for application errors, a stable `code`. Send `X-Correlation-Id` to trace a request.

post.summary:
Request password reset email.
Always returns 200 (even if email not found) to prevent enumeration.
Reset password using token from email.

Idempotently push all active paid plans to Culqi as recurrent plans. Safe to re-run —
EnsurePlanAsync no-ops when Plan.CulqiPlanId is already set. Backoffice superadmin only.

Upgrade or downgrade to a different paid plan using the card already on file.
Creates the new Culqi subscription first (so the tenant is never unsubscribed),
then cancels the old one. The old/new are persisted atomically in DB.

Culqi webhook receiver. Signature MUST be verified — anyone can POST here.
Body is read raw to preserve byte ordering for HMAC.
